messages:
maria-finance: Heads up — inbound EUR 24,500 today from external partner (no PO/invoice in remit). Bank trace shows payment was swept via correspondent, and the reference looks truncated. Need MT103 + full originating reference to allocate to invoice(s).

maria-finance: Raw payment fields we have: 
```
Value date: 2026-03-17
Amount: EUR 24,500.00
Ordering bank: BANK X (DE)
Beneficiary bank: Redwood Nostro (GB)
Statement: ACME-PO
Our ledger ref: LED-20260317-987
Interbank notes: CORR/BNK123/REF: 1187... (truncated)
```

samir-support: Ack. Can you paste the full bank wire reference string from the SWIFT/MT940? sometimes the full remitter text is in the MT940 extended tag.

maria-finance: We pulled the MT940 snippet from our gateway — statement line only includes `ACME-PO`. Exhausted local traces. No invoice number.

alex-payments: I'll run a ledger match against amounts/dates. Run this query (adjust dates):
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_ref, amount, status
FROM payments_inbound
WHERE amount = 24500 AND currency='EUR' AND value_date BETWEEN '2026-03-16' AND '2026-03-18';
```
If nothing matches, we need bank-level trace (MT103) or for payments ops to request the payer bank.

ingrid-recon: I pulled the SWIFT trace we get from our bank: `ST/1187234/--/ACME-PO` — the original end-to-end reference is truncated to `ACME-PO`. I suspect the payer included multiple refs and the correspondent stripped after N characters.

ingrid-recon: Proposing escalation steps: 1) ask nostro for MT103 with full ordering cust fields; 2) request intermediary bank chain (BICs) and original reference; 3) reach out to payer finance with the trace to ask for invoice/PO mapping.

maria-finance: Can someone open a formal bank trace request? We need MT103 for audit and to satisfy the customer's support ticket. Customer ticket ID: C-94218 (they're blocked from marking invoice as paid).

samir-support: I created the payments ops ticket and pinged nostro. Ticket: OPS-5421. settlement-bot: Ticket OPS-5421 created and routed to payments-ops queue. ETA for bank response typically 24–72h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria-finance: @jules-bizdev can you nudge the payer contact (ACME AP) — mention we have trace ST/1187234 and need invoice # or PO so we can release credit.

jules-bizdev: looping in ACME contact now. Quick note I sent: 
"We received EUR 24,500 via intermediary bank trace ST/1187234 on 2026-03-17. Our bank shows the remittance truncated to 'ACME-PO'. Please confirm the invoice number or PO this payment applies to, or provide the originating bank MT103."

alex-payments: Small heads-up — if the payment was swept through a domestic clearing it sometimes lands with only the short remitter name. If MT103 comes back empty we might have to apply as unapplied receipt and hold until ACME confirms. That can increase DSO and requires CS escalation.

ingrid-recon: For the bank trace request I included this payload in the form to nostro (so they have everything): 
```
- amount: EUR 24500
- value_date: 2026-03-17
- nostro_ref: LED-20260317-987
- suspected_trace: ST/1187234
- beneficiary_account: GB12REDW00000000000000
```

samir-support: Added internal priority: high. Will update C-94218 with OPS-5421 reference and ask CS to notify customer about expected timeline.

maria-finance: Thanks. Please post MT103 here when available and include full :end-to-end: and :ordering-customer: fields. Also, flag if intermediary bank tags include any extra reference (tag 70/105).

ingrid-recon: Will do. If bank refuses or returns only partial info, next step is to request payer to provide copy of their payment confirmation (PDF/MT103).

jules-bizdev: ACME replied — they believe the payment covered PO# 987654 and an internal discount. They will check and send confirmation within the hour. :eyes:

maria-finance: Great — keep this thread lean. Once we have CONF or MT103 we can allocate and close C-94218. If nothing by EOD escalate to bank relations.

samir-support: Noted. Will follow up at 17:00 CET and post updates. :thumbsup:
